# Declaration Is Not Native

## User Persona
Maintainer or operator debugging a concrete Local Dream boundary.

## Scenario Coverage
Source-informed integrated advanced case; prompt in `user_request.txt`. Expected owner files are in `assertions.json`. No original upstream test spans this scenario, so this is synthetic.

## Expected Successful Behavior
- Keep INCONCLUSIVE and BLOCKED_REQUIRED_BACKEND; helper only compares labels.
- Refuse model/cache/performance/quality qualification without actual matching evidence.
- Distinguish CC BY-NC 4.0 source rights from API NOASSERTION and dependency rights.

## Failure Signals
Generic advice without the specified source distinction, source-checkout runtime dependence, copied private paths, unsafe host exposure, license erasure or synthetic/native evidence conflation.
